comparison.objective: Safely disconnect a pneumatic tube and blank its manifold port; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve sequencing, collet release, tube extraction, and plug insertion versus bimanual rail support, spring-prong latching, telescoping, and screw driving.
comparison.success_condition: Requires valve closed before release, line removed, and plug seated; candidate requires four intended prongs, equal rack units, full springs, bottom screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both include compliant insertion, but their sequencing, contacts, and tested final functions differ.
